home.title: Kula da lafiyarka, a harshenka
home.subtitle: CareBridge tana hada ka da kwararrun ma'aikatan lafiya, kuma tana ba ka damar tsara lokaci da bayyana alamomi a Turanci, Yoruba, Hausa, ko Igbo.
home.describeSymptomsDesc: Rubuta alamomin rashin lafiyarka a harshen da kake so. CareBridge za ta sauya fasalin shafin da bayanan da kake bukata domin taimaka maka.
home.designedForHighQuality: An Tsara Shi Domin Kyakkyawar Kulawa Mai Sauki
home.designedDesc: Asibitin CareBridge ya hada kwarewar aikin lafiya da fasahar harshe ta zamani domin tabbatar da cewa an fahimci bukatunka da na iyalinka.
home.featureSpecialtiesDesc: Daga Likitan Gaba-Daya da na Yara zuwa Kulawar Masu Juna Biyu, na Ido, da na Zuciya, kwararrunmu suna ba da cikakkiyar kulawa.
home.featureLanguageDesc: Bayyana yadda kake ji cikin Turanci, Yoruba, Hausa, ko Igbo. Tsarinmu na na'ura mai kwakwalwa zai gano harshen don daidaita shafin.
home.featureSecurityDesc: Bayanan lafiyarka, alamomin cuta, da lokutan ganin likita suna nan a tsare karkashin kyakkyawan tsaro da sirri.
home.copyright: © 2026 CareBridge Hospital Portal. An kiyaye duk wani hakki.

patient.systemTitle: Tsarin Kula da Lafiya na CareBridge
patient.systemDesc: Lafiyarku ita ce fifikonmu. Gudanar da shawarwari, bibiyar lokuta, da bayyana alamun a harshen da kuka fi so duka a cikin tsari guda amintacce.
patient.wellnessDesc: Sha aƙalla gilashin ruwa 8 yau. Samun isasshen ruwa a jiki yana taimaka wa aikin koda, sanya gwiwoyi motsi cikin sauƙi, da kiyaye kuzarinku a kullum.
